2d47f819118c19511e697b840fc10bf3cb889bbc.english: Yes, I think the Internet plays a real role in solidarity, particularly after a natural disaster. It connects people who need help with those who can act, even far from the affected area. But this solidarity then needs to turn into practical help.

5345e1e6ddbfbe527bfd31e3c59fbc79e187ac93.english: An organisation present on the ground can publish up-to-date information on what is needed, and others can then share this appeal. Sharing the message broadens the circle of those who can take action, provided that the source, date and relevant details are retained.
5345e1e6ddbfbe527bfd31e3c59fbc79e187ac93.french: Une organisation présente sur place peut publier des besoins actualisés, puis d'autres personnes relayer cet appel. La diffusion élargit le cercle de ceux qui peuvent agir, à condition de conserver la source, la date et les indications utiles.

5b7f848cc62bb169b9b035f6d0212f3a61bea9c7.english: Furthermore, online tools help to allocate tasks and resources.
5b7f848cc62bb169b9b035f6d0212f3a61bea9c7.french: Ensuite, les outils en ligne aident à répartir les tâches et les ressources.

73e3f76f038d743c06136fe62de787e44fc74b4e.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

79a6977f2b95706c8c9efe51fc05d29d0cec0d54.english: Finally, the Internet lets the people affected explain what help they need.
79a6977f2b95706c8c9efe51fc05d29d0cec0d54.french: Enfin, Internet permet aux personnes touchées de préciser l'aide dont elles ont besoin.
79a6977f2b95706c8c9efe51fc05d29d0cec0d54.review_note: Editorial English for the complete Education English-first re-audit; aligned with the revised French and independently reviewed against every source question. No translation-provider call was made for this row.

7ece83e475179f48e30b2302fb0152020d2235ef.english: Firstly, the internet can quickly mobilise people beyond the affected neighbourhood.
7ece83e475179f48e30b2302fb0152020d2235ef.french: Tout d'abord, Internet peut mobiliser rapidement des personnes au-delà du quartier touché.

a3ace476d9d997f365d7ccfa82870f0b45f047fd.english: However, a technical fault or lack of internet connection may exclude some people. In an emergency, a public message is no substitute for the emergency services.
a3ace476d9d997f365d7ccfa82870f0b45f047fd.french: Cependant, une panne ou l'absence de connexion peut exclure des personnes. Il faut aussi vérifier les appels et les collectes, protéger les données privées et conserver des moyens de contact hors ligne. En urgence, un message public ne remplace pas les services de secours.
a3ace476d9d997f365d7ccfa82870f0b45f047fd.review_note: Appels means appeals for help, not telephone calls; collectes are fundraising drives. Exclusion is not restricted to accessing information.

a5427063b9a409ff2d5f5dbb53473d12f27fb930.english: Receiving numerous offers of help is not enough if no one is able to organise them. A schedule or a form can help a team plan for the people and resources required.
a5427063b9a409ff2d5f5dbb53473d12f27fb930.french: Recevoir de nombreuses propositions ne suffit pas si personne ne peut les organiser. Un planning ou un formulaire peut aider une équipe à prévoir les personnes et les ressources nécessaires.

a782c678263b84617f77236aa7af06d2e86d21aa.english: Aid can be better tailored to the situation on the ground.
a782c678263b84617f77236aa7af06d2e86d21aa.french: L'aide peut mieux correspondre à la situation vécue.

a93a0d1f6c4ea096800fe237783574120eb35329.english: A general appeal does not cover everyone's situation. Through messaging, someone can explain what prevents them from receiving the help on offer, and the organisation can look for another solution.
a93a0d1f6c4ea096800fe237783574120eb35329.french: Un appel général ne décrit pas toutes les situations. Grâce à la messagerie, une personne peut expliquer ce qui l'empêche de recevoir l'aide proposée, et l'association peut chercher une autre solution.
a93a0d1f6c4ea096800fe237783574120eb35329.review_note: Editorial English for the complete Education English-first re-audit; aligned with the revised French and independently reviewed against every source question. No translation-provider call was made for this row.

ac64818dc62e691cc0e3527cc64ac3bdb9f52282.english: Finally, the people affected can express their own needs and stay in touch.
ac64818dc62e691cc0e3527cc64ac3bdb9f52282.french: Enfin, les personnes touchées peuvent exprimer elles-mêmes leurs besoins et garder le contact.

bbad50c01a709026260703649e005225ae79bf96.english: The team can prepare parcels more consistently, with volunteers present when they are needed.

dbd2145315445fce7311008116bb399d5a8a5606.english: First, the Internet quickly makes needs known beyond the affected neighbourhood.
dbd2145315445fce7311008116bb399d5a8a5606.french: D'abord, Internet fait connaître rapidement les besoins au-delà du quartier touché.

dea37c3d703b6242c2aa0937d0e79755909471ad.english: The Internet is thus a useful addition for sharing information, organising and listening. But posting an appeal is not enough: solidarity takes on its full meaning when help reaches the people concerned.
dea37c3d703b6242c2aa0937d0e79755909471ad.french: Internet est ainsi un complément utile pour informer, organiser et écouter. Mais publier un appel ne suffit pas : la solidarité prend tout son sens quand l'aide arrive aux personnes concernées.
dea37c3d703b6242c2aa0937d0e79755909471ad.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

e6ba193e811932492fb49139ed41d659d457d5f4.english: This way, everyone can know when to come and what they will need to do.
e6ba193e811932492fb49139ed41d659d457d5f4.french: Chacun peut ainsi savoir quand venir et ce qu'il aura à faire.

eb4f1eb584807bef71f57592ec794caab97fa623.english: People further away can thus provide what is actually being requested.

eb4f1eb584807bef71f57592ec794caab97fa623.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

eb7f7be4e8fa5666843cae873b0c973fdeafba3b.english: Receiving lots of offers is not enough if they all arrive at once. An online schedule shows which slots are still available. Volunteers can therefore choose a time when the team needs them.
eb7f7be4e8fa5666843cae873b0c973fdeafba3b.french: Recevoir beaucoup de propositions ne suffit pas si elles arrivent toutes ensemble. Un planning en ligne indique les créneaux encore disponibles. Les volontaires choisissent ainsi un horaire où l'équipe a besoin d'eux.

ee14f393422d5d876351fcec2ad85e3b8e4ced86.english: An organisation preparing parcels posts its schedule online. The morning slot is full, so the next volunteers sign up for the afternoon. This prevents all the volunteers from arriving at the same time while another slot remains empty.

f760327e26c971a42ae43a7409af7fd08f741660.english: Someone in temporary accommodation writes to a designated contact to say they cannot carry a heavy parcel. They arrange a delivery. The person can then message their family to say they are safe and receiving help.

f760327e26c971a42ae43a7409af7fd08f741660.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

fef90db6e882bf1503849a04a80c93bef0351e98.english: Finally, the internet enables those affected to say for themselves what they need.

0645f5bfb5c57f1024b97eb3fa7dade141c4ebb0.deepl_english: A garden can provide food for certain insects if the plants are suited to the location. The point is therefore not merely to make a photo look prettier: we must allow the plants to live and flourish.
0645f5bfb5c57f1024b97eb3fa7dade141c4ebb0.english: A garden can provide food for certain insects if the plants are suited to the location. The point is therefore not merely to make a photo look prettier: we must allow the plants to live and flower.
0645f5bfb5c57f1024b97eb3fa7dade141c4ebb0.french: Une plantation peut offrir de la nourriture à certains insectes si les végétaux sont adaptés au lieu. L'intérêt ne se limite donc pas à embellir une photo : il faut permettre aux plantes de vivre et de fleurir.
0645f5bfb5c57f1024b97eb3fa7dade141c4ebb0.review_note: Fleurir means flower; the flowers are relevant to feeding insects.

0e60e977ea15b563bb52a073a19948acc5644f96.english: Distributing goods is not enough if people cannot use them. We need to know what they can carry or prepare in order to offer them appropriate help, without demanding that they recount their entire life story.
0e60e977ea15b563bb52a073a19948acc5644f96.french: Distribuer des produits ne suffit pas si les personnes ne peuvent pas les utiliser. Il faut savoir ce qu'elles peuvent transporter ou préparer pour leur proposer une aide adaptée, sans exiger qu'elles racontent toute leur vie.

14a72677c6fe94e3ca0a4c4cac07a64901fb555c.english: In a charity, a volunteer might report that someone has no way of cooking. If stocks allow, the team provides them with ready-to-eat tinned food: the parcel can then be used without the need for a kitchen.
14a72677c6fe94e3ca0a4c4cac07a64901fb555c.french: Dans une association, un bénévole peut signaler qu'une personne n'a pas de moyen de cuisson. Si le stock le permet, l'équipe lui remet des conserves prêtes à manger : le colis est alors utilisable sans cuisine.

33a58d5ff4d3afd8823caecad8b3cf4ac1a3ceb0.english: In conclusion, I admire solidarity that is practical, respectful and organised. These examples show different ways of contributing; it is actual needs and resources that must guide our actions, not just their visibility.
33a58d5ff4d3afd8823caecad8b3cf4ac1a3ceb0.french: En conclusion, j'admire une solidarité utile, respectueuse et organisée. Ces exemples montrent différentes façons de contribuer ; ce sont les besoins et les moyens réels qui doivent orienter l'action, pas seulement sa visibilité.

4029d8e642b0908ed46c061d2c584a4f5c9c698a.deepl_english: A volunteer might visit someone who has requested these visits every week. They might pick up the discussion on a book they started reading together; this allows her to share her thoughts with someone who already knows her tastes, or to postpone the visit if she is tired.
4029d8e642b0908ed46c061d2c584a4f5c9c698a.english: A volunteer might visit someone who has requested these visits every week. They pick up the discussion on a book they started reading together; this allows the person visited to share their thoughts with someone who already knows their tastes, or to postpone the visit if they are tired.
4029d8e642b0908ed46c061d2c584a4f5c9c698a.french: Un bénévole peut retrouver chaque semaine une personne qui a demandé ces visites. Ils reprennent la discussion sur un livre commencé ensemble ; elle peut ainsi partager ses impressions avec quelqu'un qui connaît déjà ses goûts, ou reporter la visite si elle est fatiguée.
4029d8e642b0908ed46c061d2c584a4f5c9c698a.review_note: Keeps the person visited as the antecedent without switching arbitrarily from someone to her.

45305d8e2f9bbd464000977985fbc39fd57a17bf.english: However, donating money, getting involved on an ad hoc basis or helping from a distance can be just as useful, depending on the needs. Not everyone has the same amount of time or the same capabilities. We should not judge people’s generosity on the basis of these actions alone.
45305d8e2f9bbd464000977985fbc39fd57a17bf.french: Cependant, donner de l'argent, participer ponctuellement ou aider à distance peut être tout aussi utile selon les besoins. Tout le monde ne dispose pas du même temps ni des mêmes capacités. On ne devrait pas juger la générosité des gens sur ces seules actions.

4bb2ae38f0e30c8bb3d3d3d90035c69a20fc82d6.english: I admire this reliable presence that recognises the person beyond their illness.
4bb2ae38f0e30c8bb3d3d3d90035c69a20fc82d6.french: J'admire cette présence fiable qui donne une place à la personne au-delà de sa maladie.

4ed653f828dbc60f84740a678c144f0d00b1d43d.deepl_english: Finally, supporting an environmental project can help protect nature in your local area.
4ed653f828dbc60f84740a678c144f0d00b1d43d.english: Finally, maintaining an environmental project can help protect nature in your local area.
4ed653f828dbc60f84740a678c144f0d00b1d43d.french: Enfin, entretenir un projet écologique peut protéger la nature près de chez soi.
4ed653f828dbc60f84740a678c144f0d00b1d43d.review_note: Entretenir refers to ongoing maintenance, not merely supporting the project.

57e43e294181883f3b637e9a3da679cdebf2438b.deepl_english: I admire community initiatives that meet a genuine need without systematically making decisions on people’s behalf. Food aid, visits requested by those in need and environmental projects are good examples of this. Above all, I admire those who organise reliable support whilst respecting the people involved.
57e43e294181883f3b637e9a3da679cdebf2438b.english: I admire community initiatives that meet a genuine need without systematically making decisions on people's behalf. Food aid, welcome visits and environmental projects can be good examples of this. Above all, I admire those who organise reliable support whilst respecting the people involved.
57e43e294181883f3b637e9a3da679cdebf2438b.french: J'admire les actions citoyennes qui répondent à un besoin réel sans décider systématiquement à la place des personnes. L'aide alimentaire, les visites souhaitées et les projets écologiques peuvent en donner de bons exemples. J'admire surtout ceux qui organisent une aide fiable tout en respectant les personnes concernées.
57e43e294181883f3b637e9a3da679cdebf2438b.review_note: Restores the tentative can and avoids adding that visits must be requested by people in need.

8212931c78e065af8104a98852f76118569ab062.english: First and foremost, thoughtfully provided food aid can alleviate an immediate hardship whilst preserving dignity.
8212931c78e065af8104a98852f76118569ab062.french: Tout d'abord, une aide alimentaire attentive peut soulager une difficulté immédiate avec dignité.

87f91ac5be949081d83686fd6840de2e8db00806.english: Someone who is ill or has limited mobility may lack opportunities for conversation. Reuniting with a familiar conversation partner allows the conversation to continue, rather than having to start all over again. This meeting is entered into voluntarily, with no obligation to speak.
87f91ac5be949081d83686fd6840de2e8db00806.french: Une personne malade ou peu mobile peut manquer d'occasions de conversation. Retrouver un interlocuteur connu permet de poursuivre un échange, au lieu de tout recommencer. Ce rendez-vous reste librement accepté, sans obligation de parler.

93b29649aa1164e9e8f724b61feeeb5864a7a325.deepl_english: I admire this sensitivity to tailoring support to people’s needs.
93b29649aa1164e9e8f724b61feeeb5864a7a325.english: I admire this care in tailoring support to people's needs.
93b29649aa1164e9e8f724b61feeeb5864a7a325.french: J'admire cette attention qui adapte le service au besoin.
93b29649aa1164e9e8f724b61feeeb5864a7a325.review_note: Removes the unnatural sensitivity to tailoring while retaining the attention to needs.

b7dce82d9791ee02bd2a21c476f6becc2acbe958.french: Avec l'accord des responsables du lieu, des habitants peuvent installer un petit espace fleuri puis répartir l'arrosage et l'entretien. Les plantes peuvent ainsi continuer à fleurir et à nourrir certains insectes, au lieu de dépérir après le lancement du projet.
b7dce82d9791ee02bd2a21c476f6becc2acbe958.review_note: Restores flowering rather than the broader flourishing.

d50b588f81049fe5679cc37dd4b88839bdd750d6.english: I admire this collective effort to look after a shared space.
d50b588f81049fe5679cc37dd4b88839bdd750d6.french: J'admire cet effort collectif qui prend soin d'un espace partagé.

fe7979c4ab1fbbc06fbbc13a55c22bb415455406.english: Furthermore, regular and welcome visits can build a bond of trust.
fe7979c4ab1fbbc06fbbc13a55c22bb415455406.french: Ensuite, des visites régulières et souhaitées peuvent créer un lien de confiance.

0041d511cb800bdb5c75b5204cec3f964e2b4d53.english: In conclusion, I would restrict traffic to reduce disruption, improve alternatives and share the space. We need to offer other ways of getting around and assess the impact of the measures, rather than making journeys more difficult without providing a solution.
0041d511cb800bdb5c75b5204cec3f964e2b4d53.french: En conclusion, je limiterais la circulation pour réduire les nuisances, améliorer les alternatives et partager l'espace. Il faut proposer d'autres moyens de se déplacer et vérifier les effets des mesures, plutôt que compliquer les trajets sans solution.

017b8c7d3eac0d8fede714752a78dd7954cc8d80.english: A bus stuck in the same queue as cars is not always a reliable option. Dedicating a lane to buses and ensuring safe access to bus stops may encourage more people to use them, provided the timetables and routes are suitable.
017b8c7d3eac0d8fede714752a78dd7954cc8d80.french: Un bus bloqué dans la même file que les voitures n'offre pas toujours une option fiable. Lui réserver une voie et sécuriser l'accès aux arrêts peut encourager davantage de personnes à le prendre, si les horaires et le parcours conviennent.

0865c2ca2288502c1885effd6d55e36ad4e32323.english: Furthermore, giving priority to buses can make car-free journeys more reliable.
0865c2ca2288502c1885effd6d55e36ad4e32323.french: Ensuite, donner la priorité aux bus peut rendre les trajets sans voiture plus fiables.

114317a8a0776c22fc179bee5dc2527c5c1d33a2.english: Restrictions can therefore make car-free travel more reliable.
114317a8a0776c22fc179bee5dc2527c5c1d33a2.french: La limitation peut donc rendre un déplacement sans voiture plus fiable.

238ed77dcdecdc38faffe0fad0f427c957f9acce.deepl_english: Near a school, a few parking spaces could be converted into a pedestrian drop-off zone with clear walkways. Families would then have a designated area without having to stand amongst vehicles.
238ed77dcdecdc38faffe0fad0f427c957f9acce.english: Near a school, a few parking spaces could be converted into a pedestrian waiting area with clear walkways. Families would then have a designated area without having to stand amongst vehicles.
238ed77dcdecdc38faffe0fad0f427c957f9acce.french: Près d'une école, quelques places de stationnement peuvent être transformées en zone d'attente piétonne avec des passages dégagés. Les familles disposent alors d'un espace organisé sans devoir se tenir entre les véhicules.
238ed77dcdecdc38faffe0fad0f427c957f9acce.review_note: A zone d'attente is a waiting area, not a drop-off zone.

3e805af753b390913b725efc0fc47c0f5cd78ebf.english: A residential street may cease to serve as a motorised shortcut once it has been pedestrianised. Local residents no longer have this traffic passing beneath their windows. The city must measure noise levels before and after the change, as well as the effects on neighbouring streets.
3e805af753b390913b725efc0fc47c0f5cd78ebf.french: Une rue résidentielle peut cesser de servir de raccourci automobile après sa piétonnisation. Les riverains n'ont plus ce transit sous leurs fenêtres. La ville doit mesurer le bruit avant et après, ainsi que les effets dans les rues voisines.

50f44a1552ad9f16e345fba53064e52094f528d8.english: The aim is to share the street more effectively, without blocking access for local residents.
50f44a1552ad9f16e345fba53064e52094f528d8.french: Il s'agit de mieux partager la rue, sans en bloquer l'accès aux habitants.

515d95a1e55767da52fba4fba6b8dfd6882a0d5c.english: Finally, we can free up space for walking and socialising.
515d95a1e55767da52fba4fba6b8dfd6882a0d5c.french: Enfin, on peut libérer de la place pour marcher et se retrouver.

5430acbc207b8666ccd231837989dd5e31cabcbc.english: The measure must be assessed across an entire area, not just on a single street.
5430acbc207b8666ccd231837989dd5e31cabcbc.french: La mesure doit être évaluée sur un secteur complet, pas seulement sur une rue.

5ef2249254d63f99b1c7c3602f23e9208f32f1d8.english: Frequent vehicle traffic generates noise and, depending on the type of engine, local emissions. Taking action on avoidable journeys can limit these sources, without claiming to eliminate all urban pollution.
5ef2249254d63f99b1c7c3602f23e9208f32f1d8.french: Des passages fréquents de véhicules produisent du bruit et, selon leur motorisation, des émissions locales. Agir sur les trajets évitables peut limiter ces sources, sans prétendre supprimer toute pollution urbaine.

64a2e2a4e726da66ef62b3e53a5229b3cfcb3bb6.english: A street must also allow people to walk, wait, meet up and access buildings. Reducing the amount of space allocated to cars can make these uses possible, whilst taking care to cater for people with specific needs.
64a2e2a4e726da66ef62b3e53a5229b3cfcb3bb6.french: Une rue doit aussi permettre de marcher, attendre, se rencontrer et accéder aux bâtiments. Réduire certaines places consacrées aux voitures peut rendre ces usages possibles, avec une attention aux personnes qui ont des besoins particuliers.

82af2925f83b46120e85da3415b6e7b801d61809.english: Firstly, reducing traffic can cut noise and certain emissions near residential areas.
82af2925f83b46120e85da3415b6e7b801d61809.french: Tout d'abord, réduire le trafic peut diminuer le bruit et certaines émissions près des logements.

9a43358ffdae07740b3a4255c860d078c33b13ca.english: However, some journeys remain difficult to replace, particularly those involving equipment or specific mobility needs. We must make provision for deliveries, emergency services and suitable access routes, and avoid simply diverting traffic to less protected neighbourhoods.
9a43358ffdae07740b3a4255c860d078c33b13ca.french: Cependant, certains trajets restent difficiles à remplacer, notamment avec du matériel ou un besoin de mobilité spécifique. Il faut prévoir les livraisons, les secours et les accès adaptés, et éviter de déplacer simplement le trafic vers des quartiers moins protégés.

c0f39144471168279b9349fdb057cab388f6694f.english: Yes, I believe restricting car traffic is necessary in congested urban areas. This can reduce certain nuisances, make more room for other forms of travel and allow for different uses of space. But restricting does not mean banning it everywhere: solutions must be put in place for residents and businesses.
c0f39144471168279b9349fdb057cab388f6694f.french: Oui, limiter la circulation automobile me paraît nécessaire dans les secteurs urbains saturés. Cela peut réduire certaines nuisances, donner davantage de place aux autres déplacements et permettre un autre usage de l'espace. Mais limiter ne signifie pas interdire partout : les solutions doivent être préparées pour les habitants et les activités.

f443238538f6962653ab964c47cceab0e24e98fc.english: An employee whose bus gets stuck in a traffic jam every evening could benefit from a dedicated lane on that route. If the bus is no longer stuck in the same queue, its arrival time can become more predictable, provided that connections are maintained.
f443238538f6962653ab964c47cceab0e24e98fc.french: Un salarié dont le bus reste chaque soir dans un embouteillage peut bénéficier d'un couloir réservé sur ce trajet. Si le bus ne dépend plus de la même file, son heure d'arrivée peut devenir plus prévisible, à condition que les correspondances suivent.

11a4bfbee42b4f96824eec138dbbce035371c653.english: In a pedestrianised shopping street, a person with a pushchair can move forward without having to navigate round cars looking for a parking space. Deliveries are organised at a different time, with guidelines that also protect pedestrians.
11a4bfbee42b4f96824eec138dbbce035371c653.french: Dans une rue commerçante piétonne, une personne avec une poussette peut avancer sans contourner des voitures qui cherchent une place. Les livraisons sont organisées à un autre moment, avec des consignes qui protègent également les déplacements à pied.

1d5235a238b8c70004e423adbcc8b435a6a92ad3.english: First and foremost, a car-free street allows pedestrians to move about more easily.
1d5235a238b8c70004e423adbcc8b435a6a92ad3.french: Tout d'abord, une rue sans voitures laisse les piétons circuler plus facilement.

3047925a6edfa3686b7b7d20d2aa4c6e0fb65ea9.english: Furthermore, the city centre can accommodate uses that require space and a quiet environment.
3047925a6edfa3686b7b7d20d2aa4c6e0fb65ea9.french: Ensuite, le centre peut accueillir des usages qui demandent de la place et du calme.

3e805af753b390913b725efc0fc47c0f5cd78ebf.english: A residential street may cease to serve as a shortcut for motorists once it has been pedestrianised. Local residents no longer have this traffic passing beneath their windows. The city must measure noise levels before and after the change, as well as the effects on neighbouring streets.
3e805af753b390913b725efc0fc47c0f5cd78ebf.french: Une rue résidentielle peut cesser de servir de raccourci automobile après sa piétonnisation. Les riverains n'ont plus ce transit sous leurs fenêtres. La ville doit mesurer le bruit avant et après, ainsi que les effets dans les rues voisines.

4069e08ac274530ee6388fd7f17b103cc27bfc7c.english: Finally, removing ordinary traffic can reduce nuisance near residential areas.
4069e08ac274530ee6388fd7f17b103cc27bfc7c.french: Enfin, supprimer le trafic ordinaire peut réduire les nuisances près des logements.

579b78f9f02d5f3a972632ddb7b6a8a8f1b9bd88.deepl_english: Walking is not the only need: people must also be able to wait, sit down and access shops. Freeing up space allows for these activities, without turning the whole street into a paid-for terrace.
579b78f9f02d5f3a972632ddb7b6a8a8f1b9bd88.english: Walking is not the only need: people must also be able to wait, sit down and access shops. Freeing up space allows for these activities, without turning the whole street into café terraces where people have to buy something to sit down.
579b78f9f02d5f3a972632ddb7b6a8a8f1b9bd88.french: Marcher n'est pas le seul besoin : on doit aussi pouvoir attendre, s'asseoir et accéder aux commerces. Libérer de la place permet ces activités, sans transformer toute la rue en terrasse payante.
579b78f9f02d5f3a972632ddb7b6a8a8f1b9bd88.review_note: Clarifies terrasse payante in contrast with free public seating, rather than an unexplained paid-for terrace.

5ef2249254d63f99b1c7c3602f23e9208f32f1d8.english: Frequent vehicle traffic generates noise and, depending on the type of engine, local emissions. Taking action on avoidable journeys can limit these sources, without claiming to eliminate all urban pollution.
5ef2249254d63f99b1c7c3602f23e9208f32f1d8.french: Des passages fréquents de véhicules produisent du bruit et, selon leur motorisation, des émissions locales. Agir sur les trajets évitables peut limiter ces sources, sans prétendre supprimer toute pollution urbaine.

6bf310ce49d211a286dcac4c70bac642528cc6f2.english: On this street, therefore, the ban allows pedestrians to pass without having to dodge cars.
6bf310ce49d211a286dcac4c70bac642528cc6f2.french: Dans cette rue, l'interdiction permet donc aux piétons de passer sans devoir éviter les voitures.

76c3bbad59c94af29cedafc83e19a20d6182a7b0.english: However, arrangements must be made for deliveries, emergency services and access for people with reduced mobility. Connecting transport services must also be accessible. The transition must take account of local businesses, without promising that a ban will automatically ensure the prosperity of every business.
76c3bbad59c94af29cedafc83e19a20d6182a7b0.french: Cependant, il faut organiser les livraisons, les secours et l'accès des personnes à mobilité réduite. Il faut aussi que les transports de liaison soient accessibles. La transition doit tenir compte des activités, sans promettre qu'une interdiction fera automatiquement prospérer chaque commerce.

8843dd597eddec87bd171ddc44c1d7d1d6b24f12.english: A small square previously crossed by cars can accommodate benches and a clear walkway. People who are not having a drink or a meal in a café can also take a break there and make their way to neighbouring buildings.
8843dd597eddec87bd171ddc44c1d7d1d6b24f12.french: Une petite place auparavant traversée par des voitures peut accueillir des bancs et un passage dégagé. Des personnes qui ne consomment pas dans un café peuvent également y faire une pause et rejoindre les bâtiments voisins.

b8141ebe963af6bc0b997a23601df85612d5db26.english: I am in favour of city centre zones closed to ordinary motor vehicle traffic, but not of a blanket ban without proper preparation. In a densely populated area, priority can be given to walking and shared use. However, the boundaries, necessary exceptions and alternative means of access must be clearly defined.
b8141ebe963af6bc0b997a23601df85612d5db26.french: Je suis favorable à des zones de centre-ville interdites à la circulation automobile ordinaire, mais pas à une interdiction uniforme sans préparation. Dans un espace dense, on peut privilégier la marche et les usages partagés. Il faut toutefois définir le périmètre, les exceptions nécessaires et les moyens d'y accéder autrement.

c967cc9ee0f4618dbae0b73a9a629d4bc1f2be15.english: The reclaimed space must remain genuinely shared.
c967cc9ee0f4618dbae0b73a9a629d4bc1f2be15.french: L'espace récupéré doit rester réellement partagé.

e46fbb073f8185412163aec1ce36693b06513719.deepl_english: In a narrow, busy street, pedestrians and vehicles can get in each other’s way at every junction. Restricting car access prevents these repeated encounters, provided that entrances and crossings are clearly signposted.
e46fbb073f8185412163aec1ce36693b06513719.english: In a narrow, busy street, pedestrians and vehicles can get in each other's way whenever they cross paths. Restricting car access prevents these repeated encounters, provided that entrances and crossings are clearly signposted.
e46fbb073f8185412163aec1ce36693b06513719.french: Dans une rue étroite et fréquentée, piétons et véhicules peuvent se gêner à chaque croisement. Limiter l'accès des voitures évite ces croisements répétés, à condition de bien signaler les entrées et les passages.
e46fbb073f8185412163aec1ce36693b06513719.review_note: Croisement means crossing paths here, not a road junction.

eb319ffddbcde7bbe24189e497e84ff18449a8d6.english: The ban must improve life in the neighbourhood without simply shifting all the nuisances to neighbouring streets.
eb319ffddbcde7bbe24189e497e84ff18449a8d6.french: L'interdiction doit améliorer la vie du quartier sans déplacer toutes les nuisances vers les rues voisines.

f6a088b7be84ac5369f07df38bb1934d0778c662.english: In conclusion, I advocate for well-justified and well-organised pedestrian zones, not a blanket closure of the entire city centre. Safety, shared use of space and the reduction of nuisance must guide the decision, with appropriate access points.
f6a088b7be84ac5369f07df38bb1934d0778c662.french: En conclusion, je défends des zones piétonnes justifiées et organisées, pas une fermeture aveugle de tout le centre. Sécurité, usages partagés et réduction des nuisances doivent guider la décision, avec des accès adaptés.

03089f8a74ce10de8a91807f62d08d2680b4c165.english: A grandfather had left his job before checking the cost of his training. When his granddaughter considers taking a course to change careers, he advises her to check whether her savings would cover the course fees before resigning.
03089f8a74ce10de8a91807f62d08d2680b4c165.french: Un grand-père avait quitté son emploi avant de vérifier le coût de sa formation. Quand sa petite-fille envisage de se former à un autre métier, il lui conseille de vérifier si ses économies suffisent à payer les cours avant de démissionner.
03089f8a74ce10de8a91807f62d08d2680b4c165.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

04a5cb7aab6c3527479099b76b44bde5461f1e50.english: We can keep the idea of showing initiative while adapting the method to current practices.
04a5cb7aab6c3527479099b76b44bde5461f1e50.french: On peut retenir l'idée de faire preuve d'initiative en adaptant la méthode aux pratiques actuelles.
04a5cb7aab6c3527479099b76b44bde5461f1e50.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

10b90e85759624c3081a7007314ed2f319cd6716.english: A grandparent advises handing a CV directly to a company. However, the company requires an online application with a reference number: that approach alone is not enough.
10b90e85759624c3081a7007314ed2f319cd6716.french: Un grand-parent conseille de déposer un CV directement dans une entreprise. Or, celle-ci exige une candidature en ligne avec un numéro de dossier : cette démarche seule ne suffit pas.
10b90e85759624c3081a7007314ed2f319cd6716.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

1158fc6579c03b0fea0fd612737a7811b025512e.english: First and foremost, the experience of older people can help us avoid certain mistakes.
1158fc6579c03b0fea0fd612737a7811b025512e.french: Tout d'abord, l'expérience des aînés peut nous aider à éviter certaines erreurs.

20b7f4ae1a1bf19b429b4af45f3ce4989b190a32.english: Of course, rejecting advice simply because it comes from an older person would be unfair. Many remain very well informed. I would also check whether a friend my own age really knows the subject and understands my situation.
20b7f4ae1a1bf19b429b4af45f3ce4989b190a32.french: Bien sûr, rejeter un avis simplement parce qu'il vient d'une personne âgée serait injuste. Beaucoup restent très informées. Je vérifierais aussi si un ami de mon âge connaît vraiment le sujet et comprend ma situation.
20b7f4ae1a1bf19b429b4af45f3ce4989b190a32.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2ca484cd3083927aaa8833b6b5d53047dfb08daf.english: Older people often give good advice, but I would not say "always". Their experience deserves to be listened to. That does not mean it provides an appropriate answer to every situation or that we should follow advice solely out of respect.
2ca484cd3083927aaa8833b6b5d53047dfb08daf.french: Les personnes âgées donnent souvent de bons conseils, mais je ne dirais pas « toujours ». Leur expérience mérite d'être écoutée. Cela ne veut pas dire qu'elle apporte une réponse adaptée à chaque situation ni qu'on doive suivre un avis uniquement par respect.
2ca484cd3083927aaa8833b6b5d53047dfb08daf.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2cae6e67791cff815e622eb87cd4d22e02204fe9.english: Someone who has already been through a situation can explain what they had not anticipated and the consequences of their choice. This account gives us specific things to check, which are far more useful than simply being encouraged to be careful.
2cae6e67791cff815e622eb87cd4d22e02204fe9.french: Une personne qui a déjà traversé une situation peut expliquer ce qu'elle n'avait pas prévu et les conséquences de son choix. Ce récit donne des points précis à vérifier, bien plus utiles qu'un simple encouragement à faire attention.
2cae6e67791cff815e622eb87cd4d22e02204fe9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

386ced74c80883e8e56df5419ae847d451208b89.english: A grandfather who has changed careers might explain that he left his job before checking the cost of his training. He advises his granddaughter to weigh up the costs against her savings before resigning.
386ced74c80883e8e56df5419ae847d451208b89.french: Un grand-père qui a changé de métier peut expliquer qu'il avait quitté son emploi avant de vérifier le coût de sa formation. Il conseille à sa petite-fille de comparer les frais et ses économies avant de démissionner.

3951fe37b4abe634909f1789473a6ad5ff03b5ba.english: However, it would be just as unfair to reject advice simply because it comes from an older person. They may well be very familiar with current practices. The right approach is to ask for their reasons, check the relevant facts and take responsibility for your own choice.
3951fe37b4abe634909f1789473a6ad5ff03b5ba.french: Cependant, il serait tout aussi injuste de rejeter un conseil parce qu'il vient d'une personne âgée. Elle peut très bien connaître les pratiques actuelles. Le bon réflexe est de demander ses raisons, de vérifier les faits utiles et de garder la responsabilité de son choix.

427c32ec6783e8802bb4a36dc5d8583452fd5d9a.english: Next, past experience does not provide all the answers to today's problems.
427c32ec6783e8802bb4a36dc5d8583452fd5d9a.french: Ensuite, l'expérience du passé ne donne pas toutes les réponses aux problèmes actuels.
427c32ec6783e8802bb4a36dc5d8583452fd5d9a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4e19ce14d42bbb5d8cc9de144565a3b0f35ddfa9.english: Furthermore, a loved one who knows us well is better placed to take our needs into account.
4e19ce14d42bbb5d8cc9de144565a3b0f35ddfa9.french: Ensuite, un proche qui nous connaît bien peut mieux tenir compte de nos besoins.

58b31cb3550583721bd16a0d2b67ff1292dae8df.english: In conclusion, I recommend listening to older people with respect, but not obeying them automatically. Experience, active listening and adapting to the context are what make advice valuable, far more so than age alone.
58b31cb3550583721bd16a0d2b67ff1292dae8df.french: En conclusion, je recommande d'écouter les aînés avec respect, mais pas d'obéir automatiquement. L'expérience, l'écoute et l'adaptation au contexte font la qualité d'un conseil, bien davantage que l'âge seul.

642b43d8e0149ffd0111e04ab5d55d9e8271e7bd.english: Lived experience can first help us avoid repeating a mistake.
642b43d8e0149ffd0111e04ab5d55d9e8271e7bd.french: L'expérience vécue peut d'abord nous éviter de refaire une erreur.
642b43d8e0149ffd0111e04ab5d55d9e8271e7bd.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

65e8d31b8e01ca40116da28399f0a04a552a5a10.english: But this experience comes from the past, and some rules have changed.
65e8d31b8e01ca40116da28399f0a04a552a5a10.french: Mais cette expérience vient du passé, et certaines règles ont changé.
65e8d31b8e01ca40116da28399f0a04a552a5a10.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

7a1b2cf632dec4d7f2bb336ba28bbc25c17c671a.english: A grandmother recommends a stable job close to the family. Her granddaughter has received a job offer abroad in the field she studied. They discuss the risks, but the young woman chooses the role because it lets her start working in her chosen field.
7a1b2cf632dec4d7f2bb336ba28bbc25c17c671a.french: Une grand-mère recommande un emploi stable près de la famille à sa petite-fille. Celle-ci a reçu une offre à l'étranger dans le domaine qu'elle a étudié. Elles discutent des risques, mais la jeune femme choisit ce poste pour commencer à travailler dans sa spécialité.
7a1b2cf632dec4d7f2bb336ba28bbc25c17c671a.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.deepl_english: A loved one who listens to our wishes and constraints can help us weigh up various options to find the one that suits us best. This quality depends on the relationship, not automatically on their age.
7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.english: Someone close to us who listens to what we want and the constraints we face can help us compare several options to find one that suits us. This quality depends on the relationship, not automatically on their age.
7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.french: Un proche qui écoute nos envies et nos contraintes peut nous aider à comparer plusieurs possibilités pour trouver celle qui nous convient. Cette qualité dépend de la relation, pas automatiquement de son âge.
7a968ce9f397a8282a172f77d14f79b6e228ecfa.review_note: Keep un proche broad and the listening/constraints wording natural; finding a suitable option does not claim it is the best one.

7c58fa55f24b14bde8d0eeeb5a78033305c71eb6.english: A grandmother recommends a stable job near the family to her granddaughter, who wants to work abroad. They compare the risks and budget, but the young woman keeps her plan to leave.
7c58fa55f24b14bde8d0eeeb5a78033305c71eb6.french: Une grand-mère recommande un emploi stable près de la famille à sa petite-fille, qui souhaite travailler à l'étranger. Elles comparent les risques et le budget, mais la jeune femme garde son projet de départ.
7c58fa55f24b14bde8d0eeeb5a78033305c71eb6.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

801dcc672233acbb7ef52a8d6048721e43e9898d.english: Someone who has been through a similar situation can explain what went wrong and what they would do differently. Their account can help us avoid a mistake, without us having to follow exactly in their footsteps.
801dcc672233acbb7ef52a8d6048721e43e9898d.french: Une personne qui a traversé une situation proche peut expliquer ce qui a mal tourné et ce qu'elle ferait autrement. Son récit peut nous éviter une erreur, sans qu'on soit obligé de reproduire exactement son parcours.

80b8e1179e39f9d31490abe9070802d679476227.english: A grandfather might advise you to take your CV straight to a company, just as he used to do. But if the vacancy requires you to apply via a platform, following his advice is no substitute for applying online.
80b8e1179e39f9d31490abe9070802d679476227.french: Un grand-père peut conseiller de passer directement dans une entreprise avec son CV, comme il le faisait. Mais si l'offre demande de candidater sur une plateforme, suivre son conseil ne remplace pas la candidature en ligne.

875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.deepl_english: This advice helps you to make a choice, without deciding for someone else.
875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.english: This advice helps the other person make a choice, without making the decision for them.
875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.french: Ce conseil aide à choisir, sans décider à la place de l'autre.
875dc0380fc9426adbab02acf879a312354b4c8b.review_note: Preserves the distinction between the adviser and the person receiving advice.

8d3cb1a747947cb78124ab2f523273cd4a40d17b.english: Finally, even well-informed advice may not match our priorities.
8d3cb1a747947cb78124ab2f523273cd4a40d17b.french: Enfin, même un conseil bien informé peut ne pas correspondre à nos priorités.
8d3cb1a747947cb78124ab2f523273cd4a40d17b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

8feb43e10d0e3e11289c3feae624779394a12253.english: In conclusion, experience deserves to be listened to, not followed blindly. Good advice depends on relevance and listening, not just age.
8feb43e10d0e3e11289c3feae624779394a12253.french: En conclusion, l'expérience mérite d'être écoutée, pas suivie aveuglément. Un bon conseil dépend de sa pertinence et de l'écoute, pas seulement de l'âge.
8feb43e10d0e3e11289c3feae624779394a12253.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

938a01c7200e6f925b74d397ebe0fa9004a36c41.english: Some people value security, others creativity or freedom. An older person may want to protect us by recommending what they themselves would choose. To be useful, advice must also take our abilities and wishes into account.
938a01c7200e6f925b74d397ebe0fa9004a36c41.french: Certains privilégient la sécurité, d'autres la créativité ou la liberté. Un aîné peut vouloir nous protéger en recommandant son propre choix. Pour qu'un conseil soit utile, il faut aussi qu'il tienne compte de nos capacités et de nos envies.

97e920e0ea362d09e5a400ebab973eb56b106c3c.english: The student can consider a solution instead of making a final decision in the heat of disappointment.
97e920e0ea362d09e5a400ebab973eb56b106c3c.french: L'étudiant peut envisager une solution au lieu de prendre une décision définitive sous le coup de la déception.
97e920e0ea362d09e5a400ebab973eb56b106c3c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9972a676c0e1031d608abc4b48067136f9b93d7a.english: I disagree with the word ‘always’. Older people can give very useful advice, but age is no guarantee. What matters is their experience, but also what they know about our situation and current realities.
9972a676c0e1031d608abc4b48067136f9b93d7a.french: Je ne suis pas d'accord avec le mot « toujours ». Les personnes âgées peuvent donner des conseils très utiles, mais l'âge n'est pas une garantie. Ce qui compte, c'est leur expérience, mais aussi ce qu'elles savent de notre situation et des réalités actuelles.

9a350f126ebb71d01e27ffa80e4af0f4f687ecee.english: The advice helps her think things through, but does not replace the decision of the person concerned.
9a350f126ebb71d01e27ffa80e4af0f4f687ecee.french: Le conseil aide à réfléchir, mais ne remplace pas la décision de la personne concernée.
9a350f126ebb71d01e27ffa80e4af0f4f687ecee.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

9a9c0c03b3e3fe3c0a09509461228a20a097f729.english: Finally, advice based on an old method may no longer be appropriate today.
9a9c0c03b3e3fe3c0a09509461228a20a097f729.french: Enfin, un conseil fondé sur une ancienne méthode peut ne plus convenir aujourd'hui.

a051b9bb8324dd2d258fd3a779523080bdb646d4.english: Recruitment procedures and training programmes are constantly evolving. A solution that worked in the past may no longer be acceptable, even if the person recommending it has good intentions.
a051b9bb8324dd2d258fd3a779523080bdb646d4.french: Les procédures de recrutement ou les formations évoluent. Une solution qui a fonctionné autrefois peut ne plus être acceptée, même si la personne la recommande avec de bonnes intentions.

a58283e5b8e0620ab4c041ad641de7e53831ba87.english: So I would listen to older people without following their advice blindly. Their experience is valuable, but it needs to be checked against current facts, while preserving the freedom to make your own choice.
a58283e5b8e0620ab4c041ad641de7e53831ba87.french: Donc, j'écouterais les personnes âgées sans suivre leurs conseils aveuglément. Leur expérience est précieuse, mais il faut la confronter aux faits actuels et garder la liberté de faire son propre choix.
a58283e5b8e0620ab4c041ad641de7e53831ba87.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a6de2da256df356138c114af2ef9d178126947e4.english: After a first failure, we sometimes think everything is over. An older person can explain how they overcame a similar experience. Their advice is then based on lived experience, not just reassuring words.
a6de2da256df356138c114af2ef9d178126947e4.french: Après un premier échec, on pense parfois que tout est terminé. Une personne plus âgée peut raconter comment elle a surmonté une expérience comparable. Son conseil s'appuie alors sur du vécu, pas seulement sur une formule rassurante.
a6de2da256df356138c114af2ef9d178126947e4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a8f36653883ecbcabfd7925e3c382876aa0b6ed9.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ac0772aa8043fcf79cd84a8802c9240be41c64f4.english: A loved one who listens to our wishes and constraints can help us distinguish our own plans from the expectations of others. This quality depends on the relationship, not automatically on their age.
ac0772aa8043fcf79cd84a8802c9240be41c64f4.french: Un proche qui écoute nos envies et nos contraintes peut nous aider à distinguer notre projet des attentes des autres. Cette qualité dépend de la relation, pas automatiquement de son âge.

aefbf88a778a590a74ece641822dccd1a2ce6960.english: Older people often give good advice, but not always. Their experience can help us gain perspective. aefbf88a778a590a74ece641822dccd1a2ce6960.french: Les personnes âgées donnent souvent de bons conseils, mais pas toujours. Leur expérience peut aider à prendre du recul. aefbf88a778a590a74ece641822dccd1a2ce6960.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

bdbd64dca3267b48ed4120147d60bc20326b8612.english: A grandmother recommends a stable job near the family to her granddaughter, who wants to work abroad. They can compare the risks and budget without condemning her decision to leave.

bdbd64dca3267b48ed4120147d60bc20326b8612.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c65c86fe9f627238e5fc982cd102d9408ec32678.english: Conversely, rejecting advice simply because it comes from an older person would be unfair. Many remain very well informed. I prefer to ask what their advice is based on, then see whether those reasons fit my situation.
c65c86fe9f627238e5fc982cd102d9408ec32678.french: À l'inverse, rejeter un conseil simplement parce qu'il vient d'une personne âgée serait injuste. Beaucoup restent très informées. Je préfère demander ce qui justifie leur avis, puis voir si ces raisons correspondent à ma situation.
c65c86fe9f627238e5fc982cd102d9408ec32678.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c8d8f219940847ac099a31f4a2a17bb2f3f780c0.english: Recruitment, training and housing conditions change. Advice may be well intentioned but based on outdated assumptions. Before acting, we therefore need to check the information relevant to the current situation.

c8d8f219940847ac099a31f4a2a17bb2f3f780c0.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

01ed459dfdc29280cda582d2a0a90e58136a6cbb.english: A relationship built on trust allows us to hear a different point of view and try an activity we might not have chosen on our own. This openness can enrich our lives without us having to follow every piece of advice.
01ed459dfdc29280cda582d2a0a90e58136a6cbb.french: Une relation de confiance permet de recevoir un avis différent et d'essayer une activité que l'on n'aurait pas choisie seul. Cette ouverture peut enrichir notre vie sans qu'on soit obligé de suivre tous les conseils.

1230741bcebfbeefb53d496a0a1305e262fe40ed.english: In conclusion, friends can make life easier, help us feel less lonely and encourage us to push ourselves. They offer a great deal, without being essential to everyone: other relationships can also enable us to live well.
1230741bcebfbeefb53d496a0a1305e262fe40ed.french: En conclusion, les amis peuvent faciliter la vie, aider à se sentir moins seul et nous encourager à nous dépasser. Ils apportent beaucoup, sans être indispensables à chacun : d'autres relations peuvent aussi nous permettre de bien vivre.

159f43942ac7490400e4c91c53236761f1563aa7.english: A retired man with no friends joins the neighbourhood walking club. Every Tuesday, he talks to the same people, without socialising with them outside the outings.

214aad8c58d167e506415b0021c642fe1c533033.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2ae4046d5a6641fce5bc4ede2db9e21d74c67186.english: A friend who understands our situation can offer tailored advice or take over a task. We don’t have to organise everything on our own, even if their help is voluntary and depends on what they’re able to do.
2ae4046d5a6641fce5bc4ede2db9e21d74c67186.french: Un ami qui connaît notre situation peut donner un conseil adapté ou prendre le relais pour une tâche. On n'a pas à tout organiser seul, même si son aide reste libre et dépend de ses possibilités.

32453b2f9e65ba34694251aaa6fa8ee80095b693.english: Being able to meet up regularly allows us to share our daily lives. Knowing that a friend is checking in on us can help us feel less lonely, especially when we don’t see many people.
32453b2f9e65ba34694251aaa6fa8ee80095b693.french: Pouvoir se retrouver régulièrement permet de partager son quotidien. Savoir qu'un ami prend de nos nouvelles peut aider à se sentir moins seul, surtout quand on voit peu de monde.

328b9c20b116410ccf1d5cd07ac4f42fb13e85c8.english: This encouragement can thus help us to carry out a project, rather than giving up on it due to a lack of confidence.
328b9c20b116410ccf1d5cd07ac4f42fb13e85c8.french: Cet encouragement peut ainsi nous aider à réaliser un projet, plutôt qu'à y renoncer par manque de confiance.

379bf612b2fc397c09940e440f838d4f6c6bdda5.english: That said, an acquaintance does not always replace a confidant. If you need to talk freely about personal matters, meeting a group is not necessarily enough. It can then be useful to deepen some relationships, without trying to move too quickly.

3f27143a9c863b9854884699cbfd7ee5b29e8b4c.french: Une personne qui vit seule et travaille chez elle peut passer plusieurs jours sans voir personne. Un ami lui propose une promenade chaque samedi. Elle sort de chez elle, raconte sa semaine et sait qu'ils se retrouveront la semaine suivante.

6818244c7dd8a2712f982da59365d3abb93d8bdf.french: Cela dit, une connaissance ne remplace pas toujours un confident. Si l'on souhaite parler plus librement, certains liens méritent d'être approfondis. Une amitié reste aussi réciproque : on ne peut pas exiger une disponibilité permanente.

0cc62fcc3cfe94e353469a9d14c7e7e2d824bafb.english: For a medical appointment, a person can take an accessible bus that connects their neighbourhood to the hospital. This allows them to get to their appointment without asking a relative to take time off work to drive them.
0cc62fcc3cfe94e353469a9d14c7e7e2d824bafb.french: Pour un rendez-vous médical, une personne peut prendre un bus accessible qui relie son quartier à l'hôpital. Elle rejoint ainsi son rendez-vous sans demander à un proche de quitter son travail pour la conduire.

0fc267da8240c7a5c3072d994b1fe71ca3eecee2.english: City life can make life easier for an older person thanks to the proximity of services. 0fc267da8240c7a5c3072d994b1fe71ca3eecee2.french: La ville peut faciliter la vie d'une personne âgée grâce à la proximité des services. 1d435585f48f3b12541cf7f15487147a0bef38a6.english: In conclusion, city life may be more practical if the person can actually access services, use public transport and socialise. These factors should be discussed with them, rather than assuming that city life is suitable for all older people.

532d92440849367ac8d9b8bdef60bd72d531a760.english: Someone who lives near a chemist’s can walk to collect an order if the journey suits them. If they live some distance from shops, they may need to arrange transport or ask a relative to be on hand.

5f29bc13135bf0f1bfc2142604a0140349090ebd.english: Furthermore, suitable transport options can help them remain mobile without having to drive.

63ac7e22eab3c79e21612bd66bb383f2234f1c80.english: If a chemist’s or a shop is nearby and accessible, the person does not need to organise a long journey for every errand. They can more easily do their own shopping, at a time that suits them.
